description: Add a to-do for the human to a project's manager-task list (for example, 'verify DNS after propagation'). A similar open task is refused with duplicate_of.

body.description: Optional details: what to do, where, and how to tell it's done.

kind.description: What the human has to do: review (look something over), decision (choose), verify (check a result) or manual_action (do something outside Chief).

project.description: Project id (UUID) or exact project name. Call list_projects to find it.

name: add_manager_task
title: Add a manager task
